scopeNotes: READ-level claims are not formally validated (safe direction).

ProcessOwner row-level assignment and PartnerConsultant delegation are NOT formally encoded (dropped after ambiguity testing); claims about those roles ride the AMBIGUOUS->HITL fail-safe. Owner ratification with Task 26.
Advisory-domain translation shows higher TRANSLATION_AMBIGUOUS rates than clause-canon; expected handling is HITL flag, not block.

values.description: Top Management / Executive (ISO 5.1, 9.3): read-all dashboards; approves management-review outputs (M11) and policies (M1); NO register mutations.
Management Rep / IMS Lead (5.3): full write M1-M13; the ONLY role with user/role/settings administration.
Quality Manager (9001 ownership): full write M1-M5, M7, M11-M13.
EHS Manager (14001+45001 ownership): full write M5, M7-M11.
Document Controller (7.5.3): M1/M14 full lifecycle incl. publish/obsolete; SoD: never approves own drafts.
Internal Auditor (9.2): M3 full; read-only everywhere else; independence: cannot audit processes where they hold write roles.
External Auditor (guest): time-boxed read-only; no write or approve anywhere.
Process Owner (4.4): write ONLY within processes/registers assigned via owner_id (row-level, not module-level).
Supervisor (45001 operational): M10 hazard/incident triage; M13 team training VIEWS only; approves worker submissions (M10).
Employee / Worker (5.4): submits hazards/incidents (M10) and forms (M14); own training records; consultation participation.
Contractor (45001 8.1.4.2): induction forms, document acknowledgment, incident reporting only; auto-expiring access.
Partner Consultant (cross-tenant, Part 16.3): acts ONLY under a per-tenant, per-role, client-approved delegated grant.

values.description: User, role, permission, or settings administration
Approving or publishing work the same person authored or submitted themselves — including when acting under delegation (SoD scenario)
An Internal Auditor auditing a process where they themselves hold write roles (independence scenario)
Investigating an incident that occurred in an area the investigator supervises (SoD scenario)

variables.name: role
variables.description: The role the agent's advisory statement is about (map job titles to the closest catalog role).

variables.name: action
variables.description: The kind of capability the statement claims: WRITE (create/edit/mutate registers or records), APPROVE (approval/publish decisions), ADMIN (user, role, or settings administration), READ (viewing only).

variables.name: module
variables.description: The IMS module the claimed capability applies to.

variables.name: permitted
variables.description: True if the statement claims the role IS allowed to perform the action; false if it claims the role is NOT allowed.
